text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're giving this to me?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks! This... yeah, maybe I'll 
put it on my bed!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Every time you see it, it just fires you 
up to win it next time, right? ...Besides—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I sleep in bed with the dog back home all 
the time, too. Looks like you'll sleep 
like a log, huh?
